mapper.sql: M.ID AS id, M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.TENANT_REF_ID AS tenantRefId, M.USER_REF_ID AS userRefId, M.STATUS AS status, M.IS_DELETE AS isDelete, M.CREATED_TIME AS createdTime, M.CREATOR_ID AS creatorId, M.MODIFY_TIME AS modifyTime, M.MODIFIER_ID AS modifierId, M.DELETED_AT AS deletedAt, M.DELETED_BY_REF_ID AS deletedByRefId, M.VERSION AS version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER (ID, MEMBER_ID, TENANT_REF_ID, USER_REF_ID, STATUS, IS_DELETE, CREATED_TIME, CREATOR_ID, MODIFY_TIME, MODIFIER_ID, VERSION) VALUES (#{id}, #{memberId}, #{tenantRefId}, #{userRefId}, #{status}, 0, #{createdTime}, #{creatorId}, #{modifyTime}, #{modifierId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = M.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_USER U ON U.ID = M.USER_REF_ID AND U.STATUS = '1' AND U.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE M.USER_REF_ID = #{userRefId} AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_TENANT WHERE ID = #{tenantRefId} AND STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND IS_DELETE = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_USER WHERE ID = #{userRefId} AND STATUS = '1' AND IS_DELETE = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER SET STATUS = #{status}, MODIFY_TIME = #{modifyTime}, MODIFIER_ID = #{modifierId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 0

UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'LEFT', IS_DELETE = 1, DELETED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), DELETED_BY_REF_ID = #{operatorRefId}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', IS_DELETE = 0, DELETED_AT = NULL, DELETED_BY_REF_ID = NULL, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_REF_ID = #{tenantRefId} AND VERSION = #{version} AND IS_DELETE = 1 AND STATUS = 'LEFT'
